title: pittosporum senacia subsp. pervillei
intro: Pittosporum senacia subsp. pervillei, commonly known as the New Caledonian Pittosporum, is a plant species within the Pittosporaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, stress, and insomnia due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Pittosporum senacia subsp. pervillei include sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health issues. Bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
